title: middle_east_AOD_estimation: processing, feature-extraction, modelling, and evaluation code for Sentinel-2 L1C aerosol optical depth estimation over the Middle East
description: Code accompanying the manuscript "Machine Learning and Tabular Foundation Models for Aerosol Optical Depth Estimation From Sentinel-2 L1C Imagery Over the Middle East: Within-Region Skill and the Spatial Generalization Gap" (Earth and Space Science, manuscript 2026EA005451). The repository contains the AERONET and Sentinel-2 data-collection scripts, the feature-engineering notebooks, the model training and leave-one-site-out evaluation notebooks, the model predictions and metrics, and the scripts for the statistics, figures, and Supporting Information of the paper. The matched Sentinel-2/AERONET dataset itself is hosted on the Hugging Face Hub.
